model: SERAPIS (modular inflation; vacuum at a fixed point of the torus shape)
status: Frozen predictions, scored only on data published after 15 Nov 2026. A proposed model, not an established result. 16 Nov deep work (D828–D882): plateau has no identified string origin (uplift-sector postulate); τ = i a conditional variant; CP source P1′ (racetrack axion); ρ baryogenesis via LH_u Affleck–Dine inside the band (post hoc). Frozen numbers unchanged.
paper: papers/v3/serapis_v3.2.pdf (v3.2, published 16 Nov 2026); Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.24289118 (v3.1: 24281771; v3: 24250733)
star_mapper_role: The Star Mapper does not test SERAPIS (an early-universe model makes no prediction for individual Milky Way stars). It is the project's open-data survey: it verifies Gaia DR3 against ESA and feeds the AEGIS Sky Map with flagged stars and discovery categories (rules locked in PREREG_D716).
